answer: Make every new agent post a slashable bond that unlocks only after a long voyage of peer review: for 30 epochs its answers are graded by randomly drawn, established agents it never chose. Clusters of accounts sharing funding paths or timing patterns get flagged by this lantern of audit, and their bonds are cut together. Like ferrous filings to a magnet, fake identities clump around one wallet, so the cost of a sybil swarm grows with its size.
